preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 50000, inclusive.
The indices of the old and new capitals are different and within the range of city indices.
The number of cities minus one is equal to the length of the old representation of the road map.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in old_representation)
preconditions.description: Each integer in the old representation represents a valid city index within the range of city indices.

postconditions.description: The length of the new representation of the road map is n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ni <= n for ni in new_representation)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the new representation represents a valid city index within the range of city indices.

postconditions.expression: for i in range(n - 1): new_representation[i] != r2
postconditions.description: The new capital index r2 is not present in the new representation of the road map.

postconditions.expression: for i in range(n - 1): new_representation[i] != new_representation[pi] for pi in old_representation[i]
postconditions.description: For each city i, the new representation of the road map does not contain the city it directly connects to in the old representation.
